text: Three, four times normal. Big wallets go Bitcoin to Monero, round the houses, back to Bitcoin.
style: Young man, a cryptocurrency trader in his early twenties, British-Nigerian, jittery on caffeine and increasingly frightened by what he has noticed. Speak with a consistent south-east London (Peckham) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Mid-to-high pitch; fast, nervy pace, over-explaining.
